text:
mei_fin: Heads-up: our week-long pricing experiment for reseller coupon "exp-aug-demo" appears to have been applied twice on some Azure Marketplace invoices. Saw weird negative net prices in the export.
sam.billing: Example lines?
mei_fin: From export: ```invoice_id,sku,partner_id,coupon_code,units,unit_price,amount
az-2026-09-03-310,ml-pro,res-112,exp-aug-demo,10,5.00,-10.00
``` That negative amount suggests two 100% coupons or a double-apply.
dev_ops: We rolled coupon-apply v1.9 yesterday to support stacked coupons. Looks like the filter that prevents duplicate coupon id application didn't run for marketplace flows.
olga_partners: Partner ops confirms they only issued a single exp-aug-demo code per subscription. They also forwarded the partner side logs showing one coupon send.
couponbot: Automation: sandbox run shows stack: applied coupon exp-aug-demo (100%), then applied promo fallback exp-aug-demo (also 100%) due to a bug in id canonicalization.
sam.billing: Short term, stop auto-apply of experiment coupons on marketplace imports and put affected invoices on hold. Long term, patch the dedupe logic so coupon IDs are normalized before matching.
dev_ops: Creating hotfix branch billing/fix-coupon-dedupe. Will patch canonicalization and add a unit test for marketplace import path. ETA 1.5h. PR link when ready.
invoicebot: Queued reprocess job rc-20260903-coupon-fix by sam.billing. Attached export: gs://billing-exports/azure/2026-09-03/marketplace.csv (sha256: c5d4...)
mei_fin: After reprocess, we need a CSV of all impacted invoice_ids for accounting. Also notify partners and suspend any partner payouts until cleared.
sam.billing: Agreed. Putting a temporary guardrail: if net_line_amount < 0 then page finance and ops.
olga_partners: Partners notified and agreed to pause payouts. They also requested a postmortem once fixed.
dev_ops: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/711  includes tests and rollout steps. Can deploy to staging for verification.
invoicebot: Reprocess complete: rc-20260903-coupon-fix finished; 42 lines corrected, 3 need manual review. Credits and adjustments queued for 15 invoices.
mei_fin: Thanks team. Closing after manual review on the 3 lines. Please add an experiment checklist step to verify coupon de-dupe before launching future promos.
